event_name: Date 19 October 2018 Time 09:24 2018 UNITED STATES GRAND PRIX 18 - 21 October 2018 The Stewards, have received a request from Racing Point Force India F1 Team to revert to their original driver line up for practice 1. In accordance with Article 26.1 b) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations, the Stewards grant permission for the team to revert to their original driver line up, Car 11 – Sergio Perez, Car 31 – Esteban Ocon.
title: Doc 6 2018 United States Grand Prix Decision Racing Point Force India F1 Team Driver Line Up
